evidence.citation: “Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C—with one fresh, context-free agent per case. B alone is insufficient: it verifies the targeted defect, while A and C detect regressions.” The artifact also requires a “post-run checkout sweep confirming no context or expected-output leakage.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: Re-running B validates the targeted fix; re-running A and C checks for regressions. Fresh context-free runs, independent judgments, before/after evidence, and the checkout sweep protect validity, provenance, isolation, and reproducibility. These are necessary controls under the supplied bar, not materially unnecessary work.
